summary: Registering a custom OAuth app with Zoom requires creating a Zoom Marketplace developer account, configuring app details (redirect URIs, scopes, privacy policy), and potentially undergoing a review process before the app can be used by others. The process is straightforward but may involve approval delays depending on requested scopes.

steps.text: Create or sign in to a Zoom account at https://zoom.us/signup
Go to Zoom Marketplace (https://marketplace.zoom.us) and navigate to 'Develop' > 'Build App'
Fill in basic app information: name, short description, long description, company name, developer contact info
Add one or more redirect URIs (must use HTTPS)
Provide privacy policy URL and terms of service URL
Select required OAuth scopes (e.g., user:read, meeting:read, recording:read)
Submit app for review if intending to publish to Marketplace or use with accounts outside your own

blockers: Apps requesting sensitive scopes (e.g., recording, phone, admin) face stricter review
Privacy policy and terms of service must be publicly accessible URLs
Redirect URIs must exactly match (including path) and use HTTPS
Unpublished apps can only be authorized by users on the same Zoom account (unless using 'Account-level app' with admin consent)
Review times vary; no guaranteed SLA published
